chapter.verse: Tua sungin Saul pen Topa' nungzuite that ding ci-in lauphawnna khauhtak a bawlbawl hi a, siampi lianpenpa' kiangah pai-in
Damascus khua vengkhawmte ah Lampi Thu a zui numei pasal khatpeuh a muhleh tuate manin Jerusalem ah a kaih theih nadingin thupiakna laite a kensak nading va ngen hi.
Tua ciangin amah khualzin a, Damascus gei a tun laitak vantung pan khuavak khat ama' kimkot ah thakhat thu-in taang hi.
Saul zong leilak ah puksuk a, “Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?” ci-in amah a hopih awging khat za hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, “Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?” ci-in dong hi. Awging in, “Nong bawlsiat Jesu ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin kithawi inla, khuasung lut in; na hih ding thu hong kigen ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah tawh khual a zinkhawm mite in awging bek za-in kuamah mu lo uh ahih manin cih nading thei lo-in om uh hi.
Tua ciangin leilak pan Saul thoto a, a mitte a hah hangin bangmah mu lo hi. Tua hangin amaute in a khut pan lenin Damascus khua paipih uh hi.
Ni thum sung khuamulo-in om a, anletui zong ne lo dawn lo hi.
Tu-in Damascus ah Ananias minnei nungzui khat om hi. Muhtuam khat sungah Topa in amah sam a, “Ananias aw,” ci hi. Amah in, “Topa aw, hih takah ka om hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, “Kithawi inla Tang kici kongzing ah va pai in. Saul minnei Tarsus khuami khat Judas' inn ah va kan in. A hang pen, en in, Saul thungenin a om laitak hi.
Amah in muhtuam khat zong nei khin a, Ananias minnei mi khat hong lutin mit khuamuhna a ngahkik nadingin ama' tungah khutnga, ci-in mu hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ananias in, “Topa aw, Jerusalem khua-a na mi siangthote tungah hih mipa in thusia bangzahta-in bawl cih, mi tampi' tungpan ama' thu ka za khinzo hi.
Tu-in hih takah amah in nangma' min tawh thungen khempeuh thongkhiat theih nading thuneihna siampi liante' kiangpan ngah hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Himah taleh Topa in, “Amah pen Gentile mite, kumpite leh Israel mite' mai-ah keima' min a keng dinga ka teelkhiat vanzat ahi hi.
Keima' min hangin bangzahtak gim a thuak kul cih amah ka lak ding hi. Tua ahih manin va pai in,” ci hi.

Ananias zong dingkhia-in tua inn sungah lut hi. Saul' tungah a khut nga a, “Sanggam Saul aw, nong paina lampi tungah nang' kianga hong kilang Topa Jesu in na mit khuamuhna na ngahkik nading leh Kha Siangtho tawh na kidim nadingin kei hong sawl hi,” ci hi.
Tua lianleh Saul a mit pan ngalip bangin a pilhkhia om a, mit khuamuhna ngahkik hi. Tua ciangin amah dingto-in kibaptize a,
an a nek khit ciangin a tha kidim hi. Damascus khua-a nungzuite' kiangah Sawl tawlpikhat sung om hi.
Tua khit, thakhat thu-in vengkhawm innte ah Jesu' thu tangko a, “Amah pen Pasian' Tapa hi,” ci hi.

Ama' thugen a zate khempeuh in lamdang sa uh a, “Hih mipa, Jerusalem khua-a Topa' min tawh thungente a bawlsia mipa hilo ahi hiam? Tu-in zong siampi liante' mai-ah amaute thongkhia ding cih tua ngimna mah tawh hih tak hong pai hilo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Saul a theih a siamna kibehlap a, Jesu pen Khris hi cih thu a lahtel ciangin Damascus khua-a teeng Jew mite lungbuai-in cimawh uh hi.
Ni tampi a cin khit ciangin Saul suamlum dingin Jew mite kikum uh a,
ahih hangin Saul in tua sawmna thu theikha hi. Amaute in Saul a thah theih nadingun a sun a zanin khuakulh kongkhakpite encik uh a,
ahi zongin ama' nungzuite in zan hunin amah paikhiatpih uh a, khuapi kulh pan bawm khat tawh damtak khaisuk uh hi.
Jerusalem a tun ciangin Saul in nungzuite tawh kithuah a sawm hangin amaute in Saul pen nungzui ahi dingin um lo uh ahih manin a vekun kihta uh hi.

Ahih hangin Barnabas in Saul zawnin sawltakte' kiangah paipih a, lampi ah Topa a muhna thu, Topa in amah a hopihna thu, Damascus ah Jesu' min tawh hangtak thu a genna thu, cihte amaute' kiangah vuicingtak sutkik hi.
Tua ciangin Saul pen Jerusalem khua ah sawltakte tawh kithuahin amaute' lakah sungtum pusuakin om a, Topa' min tawh hangtak thu gen hi.
Hellenist-te tawh kiho a, thu kinial uh ahih manin tua mite in Saul thah ding sawm uh hi.
Thu-um sanggamte in tua thu a theih uh ciangin Caesarea ah paisukpih uh a, Tarsus ah paisak uh hi.
Tua hi a, pawlpi pen Judea, Galilee, Samaria, mun citeng ah nopna lemna ngahin kilambeh hi. Topa kihtakna leh Kha Siangtho' ompihna sungah nungta kalsuan ahih manin mimal zong khang hi.
Tu-in thu-um mi khempeuh kiangah Peter zin kawikawi a, Lydda khua-a teeng mi siangthote kiangah zong va tungsuk hi.
Tua takah pumzawt natna tawh kum giat sung lupmun ngak-a om, Aeneas minnei mi khat om hi.
Peter in tua mipa' kiangah, “Aeneas aw, Jesu Khris in nang hong damsak hi. Tho inla na lupna zial in,” ci hi. Tua lianleh Aeneas zong tho pah hi.
Tua ciangin Lydda khua leh Sharon tuipiauzang dunga teengte khempeuh in Aeneas mu a, Topa' lamah kihei uh hi.
Tu-in Joppa khua ah Tabitha (a min lehkhiatna ah Dorcas) a kici nungzui numei khat om hi. Amah pen nahoih sepna leh citpiak huhna ah a thahat, tuate a sem paisuak ahi hi.
Tua sawng tengin amah cina-in si a, mite in amah a sil khit uh ciangin inndei tungnung ah sial uh hi.
Lydda khua pen Joppa khua tawh kinai ahih manin nungzuite in tua khua ah Peter om cih a zak uh ciangin mi nih sawl uh a, “Hehpihna tawh a manlangin ko' kiangah hong pai in,” ci-in samsak uh hi.

Peter zong kithawi-in misamte tawh tonkhawm a, a tun ciangin amaute in inndei tungnung ah paipih uh hi. Meigong numeite a vekun Peter' gei-ah dingin kap uh a, amau tawh a om lai-a Dorcas' bawl puantual sungsilhte leh puantual tungsilhte Peter lak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in amaute a vekun pusuaksak a, khukdinin thungen hi. Tua ciangin misiluang lamah kihei-in, “Tabitha aw, tho in,” ci hi. Numeinu zong a mit hong hak a, Peter a muh ciangin tuto hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in a khut khakin dingtosak a, mi siangthote leh meigong numeite samin Dorcas nungta ahihlam lak hi.
Tua ciangin Joppa bup ah hih thu kithei tek a, mi tampi in Topa um uh hi.
Peter zong Joppa khua savunnim Simon dang khat kiangah ni tampi taam hi.
